pick.headline: National Guard soldier kills ABC reporter Bill Stewart in Managua
pick.fbis: The Latin America Daily Report of June 22, 1979, listed under Nicaragua that Stewart's murderer was 'said to be killed in action' and a driver testified at a hearing, among items on Somoza vowing to 'die fighting'.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Latin America, Vol. VI No. 122, 22 June 1979
evidence.snippet: …e Assembly Extends State of Siege Nicaraguan Officer Seeks Asylum in Venezuelan Embassy NICARAGUA Somoza Discusses OAS Meeting, Situation in Managua Vows To 'Die Fighting! Resignation Contingency Plans Reportedly Set Up Stewart Murderer Said To Be Killed in Action Driver Testifies at Hearing FSLN Communique Makes Appeal to Foreign Countries Reconstruction Government Vows Fairness, Reason Radio Reports on Progress of Fighting Throughout Country…
